result.title: GateWatch: Low-Overhead LLM Monitoring with Boolean Circuits
result.summary: As large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed, monitoring their behavior becomes important for detecting unsafe or unintended actions. Activation probes offer an efficient approach, but existing methods face trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, and computational overhead. Probes on raw activations lack interpretable inputs, whereas sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes use interpretable features but often rely on additive classifiers and large SAE encoders, limiting interpretability and increasing memory overhead. We introduce GateWatch, a compact, interpretable classifier that expresses its entire decision rule as an explicit Boolean logic over a small number of binarized SAE features. We explore three approaches to constructing these circuits under a specified gate budget. For efficient deployment, GateWatchServe computes only selected SAE features, enables streaming of their binary values across layers during inference, and evaluates multiple GateWatch classifiers in parallel using compact lookup tables. Across 24 tasks on Gemma-2-9B, GateWatch achieves 80.49% mean test accuracy using only 3.8 SAE features and 3.5 logic gates per probe on average, just 1.17 percentage points below full 16K-feature SAE probes, while matching or outperforming them on 10 tasks and reducing probe memory by 99.98%. Inside vLLM, 1,000 concurrent multi-layer, multi-token GateWatch classifiers retain 97-98% of baseline throughput and 99.8% of KV-cache capacity.

AI.brief_summary: GateWatch 在 Gemma-2-9B 上把安全监控探针表达为少量二值化 SAE 特征上的显式布尔电路，并配套只计算被选中特征的流式推理与并行查表服务，以实现低开销、可解释的激活监测。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文本身面向文本 LLM 的监控而非多模态推理，但其「稀疏选取少数内部特征 + 布尔规则读出」的低成本状态判别方式，可能为 LVR 中 latent 证据筛选、停止决策与内部状态的轻量核查提供线索，可供核查其在视觉-语言表征上的可迁移性。
